name: NSW IPC Public Notifications Register
reporting_scheme: Mandatory Notification of Data Breach Scheme
unit_of_observation: One public notification register entry published by a NSW public sector agency
source_threshold: Public notification is used where direct notification is not reasonably practicable; exemptions and direct notifications affect publication.
source_population: NSW public sector agency public notifications under Part 6A of the PPIP Act.
public_window: Links are published for at least 12 months; the page also lists expired entries without their former links.
source_licence: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International, subject to the IPC copyright notice
correction_process: Verify the current IPC register and linked agency notification; do not reproduce the notification prose.
limitations: The register is not a complete list of NSW public-sector data breaches.
Absence is not evidence that an agency had no eligible breach.
Expired records reflect source windowing, not remediation.
